title: CMMMU: A Chinese Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Benchmark
reasoning: The paper includes an 'Ethics Policy' section that discusses the ethical considerations and adherence to legal standards during the development of the CMMMU benchmark, aiming to reduce biases in the dataset. However, the benchmark itself is designed to evaluate college-level subject knowledge and reasoning in a Chinese context across six core disciplines, not specifically to evaluate the LLMs' understanding of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary task.
